svg.title: Local dynamic-programming implementation comparison
svg.desc: Exact total DP timings from experiments_data.json converted from milliseconds to seconds. 20Ma: lists 1.59440 seconds, NumPy 3.69492 seconds, 4 calls; 20Mb: lists 0.99080 seconds, NumPy 2.20659 seconds, 5 calls. Both implementations were called only a few times. The chart does not isolate allocation, copying, or scalar-operation costs.
